findings.description:
AmanahVault._spentIn(AmanahVault.Spend,uint256) (src/AmanahVault.sol#459-461) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- s.window == window (src/AmanahVault.sol#460)

AmanahVault._checkPayout(IAmanahVault.Payout) (src/AmanahVault.sol#360-366) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp > p.deadline (src/AmanahVault.sol#361)
	- block.timestamp < b.activeFrom (src/AmanahVault.sol#365)

AmanahVault._requireTwoTrustees(bytes32,bytes32,uint256,uint256,bytes[]) (src/AmanahVault.sol#411-434) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp > deadline (src/AmanahVault.sol#419)

AmanahVault.tierOf(IAmanahVault.Payout) (src/AmanahVault.sol#143-156) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- ! m.active || block.timestamp > m.expiry (src/AmanahVault.sol#145)

AmanahVault._spentIn(AmanahVault.Spend,uint256) (src/AmanahVault.sol#459-461) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- s.window == window (src/AmanahVault.sol#460)

AmanahVault._addSpend(AmanahVault.Spend,uint256,uint256) (src/AmanahVault.sol#450-457) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- s.window != window (src/AmanahVault.sol#451)

AmanahVault.cancelBeneficiary(bytes32,address) (src/AmanahVault.sol#309-317) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp >= b.activeFrom (src/AmanahVault.sol#314)

AmanahVault._register(address,IAmanahVault.Role,bytes32,bytes32) (src/AmanahVault.sol#436-443) has costly operations inside a loop:
	- ++ activeTrustees (src/AmanahVault.sol#441)
	Calls stack containing the loop:
		AmanahVault.constructor(address,address[3],address,uint64)
Event IAmanahVault.SignerActiveSet(address,bool) (src/IAmanahVault.sol#82) has address parameters but no indexed parameters
Event IAmanahVault.ReportAnchored(bytes32,address) (src/IAmanahVault.sol#78) has address parameters but no indexed parameters
Event IAmanahVault.SignerRegistered(address,uint8,bytes32,bytes32) (src/IAmanahVault.sol#81) has address parameters but no indexed parameters
